Location of free and paid parking lots available during snow removal operations.

The data is also visible on the [311 Montreal] application (https://donnees.montreal.ca/fr/showcase/311-montreal-info-deneigement-alertes) and on the [map of snow removal operations] (https://montreal.ca/services/carte-des-operations-de-deneigement).**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
